description.p: fooyin is a music player built around customisation. Arrange its interface from a blank canvas, start with a preset layout, and tailor its widgets and shortcuts to suit you.

Browse and filter your library, edit tags and artwork, and organise tracks in playlists or autoplaylists. Enjoy gapless playback of local music, archives, and remote radio, with ReplayGain, audio conversion, fading, and DSP chains for shaping the sound.

Extend the player with plugins for audio formats, widgets, visualisations, lyrics, scrobbling, and other integrations. FooScript provides advanced display formatting, library queries, autoplaylists, and custom widget behaviour.

description.p: Adds configurable playlist double-click actions, optional immediate playback for queue actions, and improved fullscreen handling for standalone projectM visualisers.
This release also fixes configuration and state paths in Flatpak and unintended transparency in some visualisation windows.
Adds a built-in Gallery layout, configurable artwork captions, and support for reading and writing playcounts with custom tags.
Repeat Track transitions are now gapless, HLS streams can expose timed metadata, and visualisations gain smoother playback and transparent standalone windows.
Library rescans, locked playlists, playlist colours, file operations, and several visualisations also receive fixes.
Adds playlist locking, theme import and export, standalone visualisation windows, and a WASAPI output plugin for Windows.
Filters can now use the current playlist as their source, while playback selection, spectrum analysis, and Windows appearance receive improvements.
This release also fixes output switching, metadata writing, artwork zooming, projectM setup, and a range of interface issues.
Adds per-widget splitter locking, configurable playlist tabs, and timed metadata for HLS streams. Audio conversion presets and configuration dialogs are also improved.
This release also fixes gapless playback, remote streams, playlist search actions, autoplaylists, and playback of segmented tracks.
Introduces audio conversion with reusable presets and adds PulseAudio output support.
New spectrogram, oscilloscope, and projectM plugins greatly expand the available visualisations. Playback also gains optional automatic resampling for unsupported device rates.
Browsing, tagging, playlists, metadata handling, remote streams, and the interface receive numerous performance improvements and fixes.
Adds a DSP chain selector widget, sorts DSP presets, reorganises the layout editing menu, and fixes legacy layouts overriding saved configuration.
Introduces remote stream playback and internet radio discovery through the new Radio Browser.
A new spectrum visualiser and sleep inhibitor arrive alongside major layout controls, per-playlist views, playlist restoration, and integrated playlist search.
Large playlists, library updates, lyrics searches, playback transitions, themes, and many interface interactions are now faster and more reliable.
Adds Now Playing output, playlist backgrounds, custom placeholder artwork, and improved TAK and ID3 tag support.
Artwork loading and caching are now shared across the player, while playback, metadata, playlists, scripting, and PipeWire receive reliability fixes.
Introduces a Quick Tagger plugin and adds track selection to the queue viewer, broader playlist actions, and new waveform display controls.
Queue navigation, library filtering, ratings, settings, and PipeWire volume synchronisation also receive fixes.
Adds a Tag Editor layout widget, configurable rating tags, and support for multi-chapter files.
New metadata, date, and time functions expand FooScript, while settings and layout editing become easier to navigate.
Restored queues, metadata decoding, lyrics timing, searching, and playback controls also receive fixes.
Adds Directory Browser search, wildcard artwork paths, configurable browser actions, and richer Library Tree summaries.
ReplayGain updates, metadata dates, autoplaylist refreshes, and lyrics editing also receive fixes.
Introduces the Playlist Manager, inline metadata editing, a standalone playback queue, configurable context menus, and automatic tag filling.
Artwork and lyrics tools gain new search and editing options, while large libraries and playlists load and update more efficiently.
Playback state, playlist consistency, ReplayGain metadata, and scrobbling services also receive substantial reliability fixes.
Adds playback controls to desktop notifications and an option for tab stacks to restore their last selected tab.
Device disconnection, shuffle history, library scanning, artwork caching, waveform layouts, and several playback issues also receive fixes.
Adds per-device output profiles, track-change notifications, and an action for deleting tracks.
Playback statistics, artwork extraction, waveform rendering, ReplayGain handling, and library scan feedback are also improved.
Audio output, playlists, tagging, and desktop integration receive a broad set of reliability fixes.
Fixes an equaliser build failure on Fedora.
Introduces DSP chains with a built-in effect suite and equaliser, plus configurable fading and crossfading for seeking and track changes.
Discord Rich Presence, per-widget settings, persistent playback queues, richer scripting, and expanded artwork tools offer much greater control over the player.
The playback engine, metadata handling, lyrics, playlists, scrobbling, and interface also receive extensive improvements and fixes.
Adds file timestamp preservation, FileOps presets, custom scrobbling services, and more tools for editing and synchronising lyrics.
Multi-track playback, CUE parsing, playlists, scrobbling, and looping game-music formats also receive fixes.
Fixes silent playback, archive playback and waveform seeking crashes, and several Directory Browser, scrobbler, seekbar, and status bar issues.
Introduces artwork downloading and editing, lyrics search and editing, and automatically updating playlists.
Playback queues, playlist searches, scripting, and scrobbling gain new controls and integrations.
Gapless playback, CUE handling, library updates, playlist management, and the interface also receive extensive fixes.
Improves progress reporting for library scans and waveform generation, adds a ReplayGain removal dialog, and fixes WavPack playback and scanner completion.
Introduces ReplayGain scanning, quick library search with query syntax, and a VU and peak meter.
DSD playback and artwork in the Library Tree expand format and browsing support, while search and scripting gain new options.
Gapless playback, playlists, ReplayGain editing, and library scanning also receive performance and reliability fixes.
Adds vgm7z decoding and fixes crashes when restarting some decoders or leaving layout editing mode.
Adds full-library search, command-line playback controls, album shuffle and repeat modes, ASF playback, and volume shortcuts.
The Directory Browser also gains new navigation options, while decoders, playlists, scripting, and settings receive fixes.
Adds splitter locking and OpenMPT configuration, improves the Script Editor, and fixes metadata script parsing, ratings, and Selection Info.
Introduces ReplayGain playback and scrobbling with Last.fm and ListenBrainz.
Metadata, scripting, tagging, and playback information gain new controls, while layouts, playlists, the Library Tree, and playback restoration receive fixes.
Introduces theme support with custom palettes, fonts, a dark theme, and the option to include themes in exported layouts.
Decoder and tag reader ordering becomes configurable, while playlists, archive playback, filtering, and volume controls receive fixes.
Adds an option to save all playlists, improves dialog menu labels, and fixes playlist file extensions and a waveform generation memory leak.
Introduces playback directly from archives, file renaming and moving tools, and plugins for tracker, game-music, raw audio, and additional common formats.
Playlist search, automatic playlist export, inline ratings, expanded tagging tools, and many new layout and scripting controls provide more ways to manage a music collection.
Playback, library scanning, playlists, metadata editing, audio output, and the interface also receive extensive reliability fixes.
Fixes file properties for external tracks, CUE track durations, and starting playback when sending tracks to a new playlist.
Introduces a playback queue viewer and editor, adds playlist cut, copy, paste, and crop actions, and improves performance with large playlists.
Playlist tabs, artwork, search, and layout editing gain new controls, while playback, scripting, and several interface crashes receive fixes.
Adds a volume slider mode and options for unavailable tracks and Library Tree animation.
Playback after fading, playlist scrolling, filter selection, and custom tag scripting also receive fixes.
Introduces CUE sheet support, M3U playlist import and export, artwork browsing, and audio decoder and tag reader plugins.
Layout switching, playlist tabs, ratings, and metadata editing gain new controls, while playback, library scanning, MPRIS artwork, and playlist restoration receive fixes.
Fixes startup playback when the saved output is unavailable and keeps the playback position paused correctly.
Adds an optional tray icon, periodic saving, hardware device selection, pause and stop fading, and a lyrics widget.
New scripting and playlist controls provide more display and playback options, while output device loss, artwork, sorting, and interface scaling receive fixes.
Expands tool button, layout, playlist, and waveform controls and improves playback statistics performance.
Translations, layout editing, artwork, multichannel playback, metadata saving, audio output recovery, and several crashes also receive fixes.
Introduces playlist artwork columns and improves artwork caching, playlist performance, tabs, waveform controls, layouts, and natural sorting.
Playlist crashes, high-resolution audio playback, library monitoring, startup state, and tag editing also receive fixes.
